summary: WAYLOAM now has a richer Material 3 color system, light mode, Material Symbols, a new route-based logo, persistent appearance controls, and a cleaner update experience.
highlights: New emerald, indigo and amber Material 3 palette with full light and dark themes.
System, Light and Dark appearance modes now persist on the device.
Material Symbols replace the temporary character and emoji-style navigation icons.
The new WAYLOAM mark is a flowing W-shaped route with origin and destination points.
added: Optional Android dynamic color on Android 12 and newer.
Reduced-motion preference for simpler screen transitions.
Editable local emergency contact in Settings.
More expressive route, ride, gear and safety iconography.
changed: Typography returns closer to the standard Material 3 scale instead of relying on oversized display text.
Home, Planner, Ride, Gear, Safety and Settings now use semantic Material color roles instead of hardcoded black and white.
Primary, secondary and tertiary containers are used intentionally to create visual hierarchy across cards, metrics, actions and selected states.
Navigation and major interactive surfaces keep spring-based expressive shape and transition motion.
fixed: Release notes are no longer shown in Settings when the installed app is already up to date.
The emergency contact is no longer hardcoded into the Safety screen.
The themed launcher icon is isolated to Android 13+ resources so older supported Android versions keep a compatible adaptive icon.
